chapter: New Orleans bands and Buddy Petit tours
title: Early idols: Jimmy Noone, Tio, Piron and Robichaux
summary: Asked who influenced him on arrival, Hall names Jimmy Noone and Lorenzo Tio, and recalls Robichaux's New York trip and Piron.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
